name: What types of materials are used for split wood trim repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used for split wood trim repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: For split wood trim repair, common materials include wood putty, epoxy fillers, wood glue, and sometimes wood shims or dowels for structural reinforcement. The choice of material depends on the type of wood, the size of the split, and whether the trim is interior or exterior. For instance, exterior trim repairs often use weather-resistant epoxy fillers to withstand harsh elements. A Decision Factor in our material selection at Maine Results is ensuring compatibility with the existing paint or stain, to achieve a uniform and professional appearance post-repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials include wood putty, epoxy fillers, wood glue, and shims, selected based on wood type, split size, and location. Compatibility with existing finishes is a key decision factor.
